entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and the order number, please?

Thank you, Sara. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 9th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's just not what I wanted. It's confusing and I find it very hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me which features you're finding confusing? Sometimes there's a small learning curve.
Look, I read the user manual. I just expected more. It's not for me. I want to return it.
Okay, I understand. No problem at all. Let me just check the return eligibility for you... one moment.
Alright, Sara, I've pulled up our policy. It looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Fine. I guess that's one thing that's simple enough.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
It's on its way. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
